description: Mist filling a valley at first light, Virunga silhouettes behind
capcut_treatment: Fade in 12f; Film Grain 15; temp -10, highlights -15, fade 8

description: Slow push across terraced tea hill, rows vanishing into cloud
capcut_treatment: Keyframe Scale 100>108; Soft Focus 10 on first 8f

description: Mirror-still water, single fisher's boat off-centre
capcut_treatment: Shadows +10, contrast -8 (flatten water to glass)

description: TITLE rises over the lake
capcut_treatment: Text In: Fade+Blur 8f; Light Leak 20 behind type; sub-boom SFX
notes: Lock text frame to the riser peak.

description: Hands tightening the beaded igikubwe band on a dancer's forehead
capcut_treatment: Freeze first 3 frames on the hit, then release

description: Sisal umugara mane combed out, fibres catching backlight
capcut_treatment: Highlights +12, Glow 15

description: Beadwork - ibitako shoulder ornaments, fingers threading beads
capcut_treatment: Speed 0.7x if hands rush

description: Elder's weathered face, laughing at something off-frame
capcut_treatment: HSL Orange luminance +12; keep the laugh
notes: Do not correct the expression out.

description: Drummer's palm strikes the ingoma skin, dust jumps off the head
capcut_treatment: Speed Curve Bullet: 0.3x for 6f then snap to 1x

description: Anklet of bells (amayugi) being tied
capcut_treatment: Bell SFX -10dB in the gap between beats

description: Woman adjusts her umushanana sash; fabric slides
capcut_treatment: Speed 0.6x - fabric moves like water

description: Spears and shields stacked, morning light raking across
capcut_treatment: Contrast +10, shadows -8

description: A child peeks through a gap at the dancers
capcut_treatment: Hold one beat longer than feels right
notes: The child is the audience surrogate.

description: Dancers walking into frame in a line, backs to camera
capcut_treatment: Keyframe Position to nudge with them (fake parallax)

description: Reverse angle: the line stops and turns as one to face us
capcut_treatment: Cut on the exact frame the heads finish turning
notes: Match cut to 3.01 via circle shape.

description: Lake Kivu kayak/paddleboard at sunrise, paddle spray, rider grinning
capcut_treatment: Speed Curve Hero: 1.4x in, 0.4x through splash, 1x out

description: Cycling the Congo-Nile trail - wheel spinning, red earth, green blur
capcut_treatment: Bling Shake 8 synced to wheel rotation

description: Rider POV over the handlebars, hills dropping away
capcut_treatment: STABILIZE on (Recommended); Bling Zoom 6

description: Hiking the Virunga - hand grabs a root, boots on wet rock, tilt up to volcano
capcut_treatment: Whoosh SFX on the tilt

description: Nyungwe canopy walk - steps onto the swaying bridge, looks down, laughs nervously
capcut_treatment: Keep the nervous laugh in A2 at -14dB

description: Zipline / tree swing through rainforest
capcut_treatment: Speed 0.8x; Bling Shake 10 on launch frame

description: Swimming - someone breaks the lake surface, backlit spray
capcut_treatment: Speed Curve Bullet: 0.3x at surface break

description: Coffee/tea pickers at work, laughing between rows, baskets on heads
capcut_treatment: Keep voices; warm grade
notes: Labour as recreation - do not silence it.

description: Drumming workshop - visitors and locals both hitting drums, happily
capcut_treatment: A3 drum audio swells here

description: Imigongo art being painted - geometric ochre patterns, hand draws a spiral
Akagera - herd, giraffe neck, tall grass bending in wind
capcut_treatment: Temp +8, Glow 12

description: A silverback in the bamboo, calmly chewing, looks up into the lens
capcut_treatment: HELD FRAME - let the look land
notes: Cut to blackout/music-out on the gaze.

description: BREAKDOWN - music drops out completely
capcut_treatment: Split A1 at 24.0 and 27.0; middle piece -14dB with 0.4s fades; fill with A2 wind + one slow heartbeat drum + low riser
notes: 3 seconds of near-silence. Do not fill it.

description: Woman in umushanana begins umushagiriro - arms rising like inyambo horns
capcut_treatment: Speed 0.4x + Smooth slow-mo OPTICAL FLOW. If fabric smears, back off to 0.6x

description: Her hands - wrist turning, fingers extending
capcut_treatment: 0.4x Optical Flow; HSL Orange: skin luminance +10, sat +4

description: Fabric of the umushanana sliding, sash trailing
capcut_treatment: Speed 0.3x; Soft Focus 8

description: THE LEAP - full Intore line jumps simultaneously, manes airborne, spears up
capcut_treatment: Speed Customized: 1x > 0.5x at apex > 1x on landing. Apex sits ON the downbeat. Sub-boom + real stomp at -3dB
notes: Signature shot. Ramp OFF the beat, not into it.

description: Landing - feet hit earth, dust explodes upward
capcut_treatment: Speed Customized: 1x > 0.2x for 5f > 1.2x. Bling Shake 12 for 4 frames only
audio_layer: LOUD IMPACT - loudest point in the whole mix
notes: THE signature shot of the film.

description: Dancer's face mid-cry, sweat, mane across the eyes
capcut_treatment: Freeze 2 frames on beat then release; contrast +12, clarity +15

description: Spear thrust forward into the lens
capcut_treatment: Bling Zoom 15 on thrust frame; hard whoosh

description: Shields clashing in unison across the line
capcut_treatment: A3 shield-clack full level; duck A1 by 5dB for 8 frames

description: Ankle bells in a blur of stomp
capcut_treatment: Speed 0.35x; bell audio isolated, pitched slightly up

description: Formation change - line collapses and reforms
capcut_treatment: Keyframe Rotation 0>8deg over the clip

description: A woman dancing umuhamirizo - reclaiming the warrior dance, full commitment leap
capcut_treatment: 0.5x curve. Hold her leap as long as the men's

description: Drummers - full umutagara ensemble, sticks blurring
capcut_treatment: Speed 1.1x (over real time reads as frenzy)

description: A child mimics the leap in the foreground, delighted; dancers soft behind
capcut_treatment: Blur 20 on the background plane (depth-of-field effect)

description: Ibyivugo - poet steps forward reciting self-praise verse, arm outstretched
capcut_treatment: Keyframe Scale 100>106. If he speaks, duck A1 to -10dB for the line

description: Horn (amakondera) player, cheeks full - the traditional arrival cue
capcut_treatment: Real horn hit in A3

description: Three leaps, jump-cut in sequence, same framing, different dancers
capcut_treatment: Three 5-frame cuts inside one beat cluster - reads as a drum roll
notes: Identical framing is what makes it work.

description: The mane filling the frame, whipping sideways in slow motion
capcut_treatment: Speed 0.3x; Glow 20, highlights +15
notes: Most beautiful texture in the film. Shape echo -> 5.05.

description: Whole line at the apex of a leap, silhouetted against a low sun
capcut_treatment: Exposure -15 (crush to silhouette), highlights +20 (keep the rim)

description: Crowd clapping, hands in unison, faces lit
capcut_treatment: Crowd clap at -4dB - carries into Act 5

description: THE EXHALE - one held shot: dancer chest heaving, sweat, a slow smile breaking; or dust hanging in golden light as everything goes quiet
capcut_treatment: Speed 0.35x + Optical Flow. Halo Blur 12. ONE CONTINUOUS SHOT - do not cut it. Protect from effects creep.

description: Grandmother's hands weaving agaseke (peace basket), geometric coil
capcut_treatment: Keyframe Scale 100>104; temp +12, Glow 10

description: An elder's face, full frame, still - he looks into the lens and holds it
capcut_treatment: Grain 12, soft vignette 8. NO other effect. Hold it.
notes: Stillness after 38s of movement is the point.

description: Children running a dirt path between banana trees, laughing, toward camera
capcut_treatment: Speed 0.7x; laughter A2 -10dB

description: Rolling hills at golden hour, terraced, mist returning - full circle to Act 1
capcut_treatment: Effects Nature Sunset 15 OR manual: temp +14, highlights -10, shadows +8, Glow 18

description: A face in the crowd watching the dancers - tears or laughter, ambiguous, alive
capcut_treatment: HSL Orange luminance +10. NO effect. Faces don't need help.

description: Water again - Lake Kivu, now gold instead of grey, sun on the surface
capcut_treatment: Direct colour rhyme with 1.03: same framing, opposite temperature

description: Everyone dancing - a visitor, clumsy and joyful, pulled into the line by a dancer
capcut_treatment: Speed 0.8x; crowd + drum audio full

description: Hands clapping across the circle cut with feet stomping earth
capcut_treatment: Two 4-frame cuts. Pure rhythm.

description: Full troupe + crowd, one frame, dancing together at golden hour
capcut_treatment: Keyframe Scale 100>90 AND Position Y +120px together (drone-lift feel)

description: A dancer's leap against the setting sun, silhouette
capcut_treatment: Exposure -18, rim highlights +22

description: Lake Kivu at dusk, longhorn inyambo cattle silhouetted along the shore
capcut_treatment: Sunset Rays 18 low intensity; temp +16

description: Night - a fire, sparks rising, faces lit orange, drumming continuing off-frame
capcut_treatment: Particles/Sparkle 12 for embers; firelight in A3

description: THE LAST FACE - a dancer catching breath, looks straight into the lens and smiles. Hold.
capcut_treatment: Speed 0.8x. HOLD for the final drum hit at 00:56.8

description: Wide of the hills at dusk, mist returning - the same valley as 1.01. Full circle.
capcut_treatment: Same grade as 1.01 but warmer. Ends in the same place, changed.

description: CLOSING CARD
capcut_treatment: Text In: Fade+Blur; Out: Fade. Fade to black over last 12 frames.
on_screen_text: UMURIRO W'URWANDA / Come to rest. Leave dancing. / Rwanda - Land of a Thousand Hills
notes: 3 stacked text blocks, staggered 6 frames apart.
